title: Yellow Harvest - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Yellow Harvest in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A golden field area tied to the Glaise encounters and several optional bosses. It rewards elemental Fire and Ice builds.

sections.title: How to Reach Yellow Harvest
sections.content: Reached from The Continent in Act 2 through a portal.
